text: Let \(E\) set tree edges lengths \(w_e\). two communities (cells) \(\) \(B\), define \(U_e()\) \(U_e(B)\) indicators edge \(e\) least one descendant tip present community \(\) (\(B\)), respectively. Unweighted UniFrac (presence/absence) : $$\mathrm{UniFrac}_{\mathrm{unw}}(,B) =       \frac{\sum_{e \E} w_e \cdot \mathbf{1}\{ U_e() + U_e(B) = 1 \}}            {\sum_{e \E} w_e \cdot \mathbf{1}\{ U_e() + U_e(B) \ge 1 \}}.$$ Weighted UniFrac (normalized; relative abundances) defines fraction abundance edge \(D_A(e)\) \(D_B(e)\) (\([0,1]\)), uses: $$\mathrm{UniFrac}_{\mathrm{w}}(,B) =       \frac{\sum_{e \E} w_e \, |D_A(e) - D_B(e)|}            {\sum_{e \E} w_e \, [D_A(e) + D_B(e)]}.$$ species shared tree dist used; informative messages printed mismatches. returned distance matrix diagonal 0. computing matrix, function summarizes cell mean dissimilarity cells performs ordinations dissimilarity matrix using PCoA (Cailliez correction) NMDS, returning first two axes rasterized study grid.
